 Order
Heard Mr. B.S. Rayaguru, learned counsel for the Petitioner as well as Mr. S. Ghose, learned Additional Government Advocate for the State-Opposite Parties.

2. The Petitioner, who is an accused for the offences under Sections 376(1)/384/506, I.P.C., has prayed to prohibit the Opposite Parties, particularly Opposite Party No.7, not to publish the news relating to the proceeding against him in social media.

3. Mr. Rayaguru, learned counsel for the Petitioner taking aid of the provisions contained in Section 327(2) of the Cr.P.C. submits that, Opposite Party No.7 is trying to damage the reputation of the Petitioner intentionally by regularly publishing false news regarding the proceeding against the Petitioner.

4. The prayer of the Petitioner made before the learned trial judge has been rejected on 09.07.2024 as per the order under Annexure- Location: High Court of Orissa, Cuttack Date: 07-Oct-2024 14:09:58 10.
It is further seen from Annexure-9 that, none of such alleged publications regarding the allegations made against the Petitioner are recent, but belong to much before i.e. during the year 2019.

sentences.text:
5. Considering the object of the provisions contained under Sections 327(2) & 327(3) of the Cr.P.C.,
and the facts produced on record, there appears no ground for apprehension of the Petitioner.
6. Accordingly, this Court is not inclined to interfere with the impugned order of learned trial judge.

However, the Petitioner is at liberty to move the learned trial court again for the purpose at appropriate stage since it is submitted that in the meantime charge has already been framed on 30.7.2024.
7.
The CRLMC is accordingly disposed of.
8. An urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.
( B.P. Routray) Judge B.K. Barik Signed by: BASANTA KUMAR BARIK
